messages:
Eli (Account): FinEdge follow-up: they require nCipher BYOK, offline import, signed attestation artifact for auditors, and 7-year rotation metadata retention. Can we scope before Wednesday POC? cc @Rina @Marco @Tess

Rina (solutions): We support nCipher via PKCS#11 and wrapped-key import (AES-KW). Offline import OK if they provide wrapped key blob + signed manifest. Will draft a manifest example and minimal terraform snippet.

Marco (security): Important: we don't store plaintext key material. We can store operation metadata; default retention is 1 year. Extended 7-year retention is available as an add-on (SLA + storage charge). Need exact wording for SOW. Also ask customer for HSM model and firmware to verify FIPS claim.

Tess (finance): Preliminary commercial placeholders: one-time BYO onboarding $7,500 (attestation packet included), 22% uplift on Dedicated HSM-backed slots, and $0.018 per key op for heavy KMS use. Extended retention charged at $0.12/GB/month in archival. Rush attestation available +$1,000. I will confirm final numbers.

Rina (solutions): sample manifest to include in runbook:
```
manifest_v1:
  customer: "finedge"
  key_id: "rek-001"
  wrap_algo: "AES-KW"
  import: "offline"
  signature: "<base64>"
```
Also include verification steps (openssl) in the doc.

Eli (Account): Auditor wants attestation artifact before POC to pre-clear. Can we produce a pre-provision snapshot?

Marco (security): Yes — we can issue an attestation snapshot (HSM cert chain + hashed manifest + our signature). Full runtime attestation requires the device online once; we'll label pre-provision as "snapshot" in SOW.

OpsBot: Created ticket: pre-POC manifest + attestation snapshot + cost placeholders.

Rina (solutions): Networking notes: runtime needs mutual-TLS to HSM on 8443/TCP, plus egress 443 to control-plane. If customer uses IPsec, open 4500/UDP. Will add SG examples to runbook.

Eli (Account): Action items: Rina post manifest + tf snippet; Marco draft SOW retention wording and attestation template; Tess finalize provisional quote. Internal sync tomorrow 09:30 PT.
